text.p: Secondhand tonnage brokers reported the sale of the following vessels.
Chariot - (built 1981) 124,292 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $9.85 million.
Forum Victory - (built 1977) 72,746 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $4.47 million in a pre-auction deal in Durban.
Maritime Nancy - (built 1990) 71,749 dwt sold to Turkish buyers for $19.25 million.
Stellar Joy - (built 1996) 45,654 dwt sold to Hong Kong buyers for $21.8 million.
Some of these sales may not be final as they may be subject to survey, inspection or other conditions.
